column.name: report_sql
column.value: select mc.account_no as "CustomerID", TO_CHAR(mc.created_on_utc, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') as "Date Opened", mc.display_name as "Customer Name", mcv.code_value as "Account Tier", case when mc.legal_form_enum = 1 then 'Individual' else 'Entity' end as "Customer Type", rev.enum_value as "Customer Status", concat(ma.firstname, ' ', ma.lastname) as "Account Opened By", ii."ID Number" as "BVN", mc.mobile_no as "Mobile", mc.email_address as "Email", TO_CHAR(mc.date_of_birth, 'YYYY-MM-DD') as "Date of Birth or Incorporation", gmcv.code_value as "Gender", concat(mad.address_line_1, ' ', mad.address_line_2, ' ', mad.city) as "Address", ms.display_name as "Account Officer", mcnp.incorp_no as "Incorporation No", ti."Tax ID" from m_client mc left join r_enum_value rev on rev.enum_id = mc.status_enum and rev.enum_name = 'client_status_enum' left join m_appuser ma on ma.id = mc.created_by left join m_code_value mcv on mc.client_classification_cv_id = mcv.id left join m_code_value gmcv on mc.gender_cv_id = gmcv.id left join m_client_address mca on mc.id = mca.client_id and mca.address_type_id = 18 left join m_address mad on mad.id = mca.address_id left join m_staff ms on mc.staff_id = ms.id left join "Identity Information" ii on ii.client_id = mc.id and ii."Identity Types_cd_Identity Type" = (select id from m_code_value mcvb where mcvb.code_id = (select id from m_code where code_name = 'Identity Types') and mcvb.code_value = 'BVN') left join m_client_non_person mcnp on mc.id = mcnp.client_id left join "TAX ID" ti on ti.client_id = mc.id where (mc.created_on_utc >= '${startDate}' or '${startDate}' is null) and (mc.created_on_utc <= '${endDate}' or '${endDate}' is null)
